files.Title: Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.Controls.ActivityHeatmap
files.Summary: A calendar heatmap: one column per week, one row per weekday, each cell tinted by activity intensity. Values run oldest first, top to bottom within each column. Cells grow to fill the given width, and hovering a cell shows its date and activity.

files.Title: Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.Controls.AgentAvatar
files.Summary: A living avatar for agent presence. The face is a lightweight 3D head: eyes sit on a sphere and follow a yaw/pitch/roll pose that wanders on layered noise, blinks on an organic schedule (sometimes twice), and masks expression changes behind a blink. Moods blend into each other; nothing snaps. Drawn on the render loop with no assets.

files.Title: Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.NovaTheme

Includes the Nova AIKit control themes and design tokens in an application. Add an instance to Application.Styles:

<Application.Styles>
  <FluentTheme />
  <nova:NovaTheme />
</Application.Styles>
